chunks: Yaqub ibn Yazid from al-Hasan from Ibn Bukayr from more than one of our companions from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
That he went to al-Rabadhah to see off Abu Ja'far, then entered Mecca in a state of Ihram解除 (Halal).

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far, a title often referring to Imam Muhammad al-Baqir or Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq
key_terms.حَلَالًا: Halal, referring to the state of being free from the restrictions of Ihram after Hajj or Umrah

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam do after seeing off Abu Ja'far in al-Rabadhah?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the ritual practice of Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transitioning from the state of Ihram to Halal after performing Hajj or Umrah, specifically noting his journey to al-Rabadhah to bid farewell to Abu Ja'far. In Shia jurisprudence, this incident is often cited to illustrate the proper conduct and timing of exiting the sacred state, reinforcing the chapter's focus on expiation (Kaffarah) for inadvertent violations of Ihram conditions. The mention of al-Rabadhah, a significant location near Mecca, underscores the historical context of the Imams' movements and their interactions with companions during the pilgrimage season.
